picks.title: Start in Claude Motion. Finish it in Luma. | Luma
picks.excerpt: Claude Motion videos now open in Luma so creators turn an idea in motion into video in any format.
picks.rationale: A new cross-tool integration: Claude Motion drafts now open directly in Luma for finishing. It changes the handoff from idea to final video today.

picks.title: Sci-Fi Thriller ‘Overstake’ Gets Generative AI Rebuild, Boarded by Cappu Films at Busan Market (EXCLUSIVE)
picks.excerpt: Cappu Films boards worldwide sales on Stas Mareev’s ‘Overstake,’ a live-action sci-fi thriller whose world is being rebuilt with generative AI.
picks.rationale: A concrete new deal: a worldwide sales agent signed on to a live-action feature whose world is being rebuilt with generative AI. It is a distinct film and transaction, not more panel talk from Busan.

picks.title: AI-Native Studios Can Create Original IP While Traditional Studios Keep Their Edge, VFX Veteran Hong Jae Cheol Says at Busan
picks.excerpt: At Busan’s InnoAsia AI Creators Camp, VFX veteran Hong Jae Cheol mapped a hybrid future of AI-native studios and traditional VFX.
picks.rationale: A Korean VFX veteran's model for how AI-native studios and traditional VFX houses will split the work. It comes from the separate InnoAsia AI Creators Camp, not the ACFM/Netflix sessions behind the 10-11 Eyeline card.
